detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A wide static shot of empty suburban rooftops on a quiet afternoon. Far away, out of sight, someone fires one rifle shot. The camera is static and locked-off.

overall_soundscape: One single gunshot heard from very far away: a muffled distant crack with no close detail, followed by a long echo bouncing off the houses, then quiet. Nothing else is heard: no music, no speech, no voices.
